name: Secret Handoff
tagline: Let agents use credentials for approved API requests without receiving their values.
description: Let agents use temporary secrets through the local Secret Handoff tool without receiving the values. Install the 0.0.2 binary first. Local fill only; phone and remote relay are not enabled on the public service.

install.notes: Install the secrethandoff binary first and check secrethandoff version against the release lock. The skill supplies guidance; it does not install or connect the MCP server. No Secret Handoff account or service API key is required.
